topic: Buggy's Bara Bara no Mi (Chop-Chop Fruit) is underrated: it makes him hard to finish, and the Cross Guild gives it a real role in the Final Saga
title: Why Buggy's Clown Fruit Was Underrated in the Final Saga
description:
Buggy's Chop-Chop Fruit lets him split his body and steer every piece, and most fans still treat it as a gag. This breakdown checks what the fruit actually does, where it breaks, and why the Cross Guild and the Final Saga give it more weight than the memes suggest.

0:00 The Joke With A Body
1:10 The Accident Behind The Fruit
2:00 Why Blades Fail Against Him
3:10 The Weakness Nobody Talks About
4:20 Why He Wears The Title
5:30 The Shanks Problem
6:40 What Fans Get Wrong
8:40 Awakening And The Verdict

Do you think Buggy is a joke who got lucky, or a survivor the Final Saga is underrating? Tell me which side you take.
